planningRule: Plan the route pressure before runtime. This route is not runtime active. Do not add gates, branch menus, old chamber exits, or a fifth local cell in this pass.

currentLockedFoundation.meaning: The player has awakened, learned safe absorption, learned that scar matter remembers pressure, listened through Signal Chorus, and previewed a bloom/residue fork.

recommendedFirstRoute.label: Grave Memory / Residue-Scar Route
recommendedFirstRoute.humanPressure: mourning, inheritance, unfinished becoming, and learning what old wounds become when they are metabolized instead of eaten.
whyThisRouteFirst: Scar-Flow already teaches that wounds are readable but not always absorbable.
Bloom Residue already introduces memory, bloom, braid, and warning as a first fork pressure.
The Wounded Nursery Host needs old scars metabolized before broad Act 1 expansion.
A memory route deepens the current opening instead of introducing unrelated systems.
It gives the Guide/Witness line a natural next role without adding a full dialogue tree.
recommendedFirstRoute.firstRouteQuestion: Can the player learn from remains without becoming trapped inside them?
playerLearningGoals: old cores are not loot; they are unfinished becoming
residue can nourish but also contaminate
pulse can reveal memory without consuming it
route choice should feel like a tissue pressure, not a menu selection

plannedFutureLocalCellRoles.function: first playable residue/grave listening pocket; not authored as runtime cell in HC-003G
old becoming remains; pulse-to-read, not consume-first; not authored as runtime cell in HC-003G
future no-gate tissue pressure where the route asks repair/condense/leech questions

alternativeRoutePressures.label: Silt / Appetite / Pressure Route
alternativeRoutePressures.reasonToDefer: Useful for appetite and compression, but it risks adding new movement/pressure systems before the memory foundation is clear.

alternativeRoutePressures.label: Vascular / Rhythm / Charge Route
alternativeRoutePressures.reasonToDefer: Strong future route, but it would pull toward timing/flow mechanics before the first meaning route is grounded.

alternativeRoutePressures.label: Bloom / Overgrowth Route
alternativeRoutePressures.reasonToDefer: Bloom is already previewed through the optional fork; it should become more dangerous after the player understands residue/memory cost.

routeChoicePrinciples: Route choice is expressed through host tissue pressure and Guide/Witness interpretation, not a menu.
The route must derive from Wounded Nursery Host anatomy and chemistry.
A route begins as pressure, then local cell planning, then recipe pack, then runtime morph prototype.
No old gates, doors, chamber exits, or stage node loaders may be revived.
The first route must deepen the current first playable minute rather than widen away from it.

nextPassRecommendation.label: Placeholder Visual Triage Pass
